digest.component_or_area: plan-review impact model and decision gate
propositions: Replace ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) on undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes with closed-set kind enumerations mapping deterministically to flooring or advisory contributions
The undecomposed axis shall split into three kinds: bundles_separable_slices (advisory, 0.55), missing_required_child (flooring), no_executable_breakdown (flooring)
The dod_uncertifiable axis shall split into three kinds: underspecified_certification (advisory, 0.55), uncertifiable_outcome (flooring), certification_cannot_prove (flooring)
Bump IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION from plan-v4 to plan-v5 to close the cohort per ADR 0054 section 4, batching both kind-set conversions and margin telemetry under one version
Record per-finding priority-minus-block_threshold margin in the sidecar to enable future decision-boundary auditing
Zero-LLM re-score corpus against both residual bounds and hand-audit all lost blocks to confirm none describe genuine gaps (committed outcome without oracle or broken oracle)
